name: 승천
description: 두 개의 핵이 하나로 합쳐질 때 신은 그릇을 벗고 하늘에 오릅니다.
description_en: When the two cores become one, the god sheds the vessel and rises to the heavens.

name: 기적의 근원
description: 그릇 안의 신성이 마침내 온전히 깨어납니다.
description_en: The divinity within the vessel finally awakens in full.

name: 말씀의 근원
description: 신의 말이 곧 세상의 법이 됩니다.
description_en: The god's word becomes the law of the world.

name: 자애의 근원
description: 끝없는 자비가 교단을 감싸는 성벽이 됩니다.
description_en: Endless mercy becomes a rampart around the cult.

name: 쾌락의 근원
description: 쾌락과 신성이 구별되지 않는 경지에 이릅니다.
description_en: You reach a state where pleasure and divinity are one.

name: 치유의 손
description_en: Miracles that soothe sick bodies and minds.

name: 이적의 권능
description_en: Miracles that overturn the laws of the world.

name: 계시의 문
description_en: The path of putting the god's will into words.

name: 예지의 눈
description_en: An eye that sees what is coming before it comes.

name: 자기 수양
description_en: The virtue of mastering yourself.

name: 이웃을 향한 덕
description_en: Virtue that opens itself to others.

name: 육체의 욕망
description_en: The path that embraces what the body craves.

name: 세속의 욕망
description_en: The path that covets wealth and power.

name: 강건한 그릇
description: 숙주의 몸이 신의 힘을 버틸 만큼 단단해집니다.
description_en: The host's body grows hard enough to bear the god's power.

name: 생명의 축복
description_en: You set your followers ablaze with the joy of being alive.

name: 손끝의 온기
description: 손길 한 번에 아픈 이가 일어섭니다.
description_en: One touch, and the sick rise to their feet.

name: 치유의 행렬
description_en: Those seeking healing come in long lines.

name: 불굴의 육신
description_en: No wound can bring the vessel down.

name: 단단한 살결
description_en: Not even phantom blades can pierce your skin.

name: 피의 재생
description: 해가 바뀔 때마다 몸이 스스로 회복됩니다.
description_en: Each new year, your body heals itself.

name: 고요한 정신
description: 숙주의 정신이 신의 목소리에 흔들리지 않습니다.
description_en: The host's mind does not waver at the god's voice.

name: 황홀의 전염
description_en: Your ecstasy spreads to your followers.

name: 꿈속의 방문
description_en: You enter your followers' dreams and plant Faith.

name: 깨어 있는 눈
description: 잠들지 않는 정신이 교감을 깊게 합니다.
description_en: A mind that never sleeps deepens your Commune.

name: 흔들리지 않는 마음
description: 다른 신의 저주가 마음을 흔들지 못합니다.
description_en: Other gods' curses cannot shake your heart.

name: 침묵을 찢는 목소리
description_en: The Silent Order's silence cannot reach you.

name: 맑은 밤
description_en: Nights free of nightmares guard your Mentality.

name: 황금의 손길
description_en: Wealth gathers wherever your hand falls.

name: 넘치는 봉헌
description_en: Followers scramble to make Offerings.

name: 금빛 헌금함
description_en: The offering box is never empty.

name: 기적의 축성
description_en: You learn to raise buildings by miracle.

name: 봉인된 금고
description_en: The cult's Wealth does not easily slip away.

name: 숨겨진 장부
description: 조사관이 찾지 못하는 장부가 건물을 지킵니다.
description_en: Ledgers the inspectors cannot find protect your buildings.

name: 단단한 주춧돌
description_en: The cult's riches do not easily scatter.

name: 드러난 신성
description_en: Miracles wear down the vessel less.

name: 이적의 무대
description: 기적을 보러 온 군중이 신도가 됩니다.
description_en: Crowds who come to see miracles become followers.

name: 군중을 부르는 빛
description_en: Light from the heavens draws people together.

name: 멈추지 않는 기적
description_en: Your miracles are rarely interrupted.

name: 베일 속의 기적
description_en: Your miracles draw less of the world's attention.

name: 흔적 없는 이적
description: 기적이 끝나면 아무 증거도 남지 않습니다.
description_en: When a miracle ends, no evidence remains.

name: 아끼는 힘
description_en: Small miracles cost less divine power.

name: 깊은 경건
description_en: The god's own conviction deepens.

name: 불타는 믿음
description_en: Fiery Faith spreads to your followers.

name: 타오르는 기도
description_en: The more you pray, the stronger the god's conviction.

name: 믿음의 불씨
description_en: Even a little faith soon becomes a blaze.

name: 무너지지 않는 믿음
description: 외부의 공격에도 신앙이 쉽게 식지 않습니다.
description_en: Followers' Faith does not easily cool under outside attack.

name: 흔들림 없는 무릎
description_en: Followers do not easily raise their heads in defiance.

name: 배교자의 귀환
description_en: Followers about to leave turn back.

name: 새겨진 말씀
description_en: Your word grows firm as if carved in stone.

name: 선포의 나팔
description_en: Your word rings through the streets.

name: 거리의 설교
description_en: Your Revelation works even in the public square.

name: 경전의 확산
description_en: Those who read your scripture come seeking you.

name: 논쟁의 방패
description: 기성 종교의 반박이 교리를 깎지 못합니다.
description_en: Rebuttals from established religions cannot erode your Doctrine.

name: 이단 반박
description_en: You turn accusations of heresy back on the accusers.

name: 정통의 증명
description_en: Other gods find it harder to pick faults.

name: 신과의 끈
description_en: The bond between god and vessel grows thicker.

name: 넘치는 신성
description: 기적에 드는 힘이 줄고 교감이 쉬워집니다.
description_en: Miracles cost less power and Commune comes easier.

name: 끈의 공명
description_en: The bond resonates every time you Commune.

name: 나누는 계시
description_en: You share the visions from your Commune with your followers.

name: 끊기지 않는 끈
description_en: Other gods struggle to sever your bond.

name: 침묵 저항
description_en: You withstand attempts to block your Communion.

name: 신들의 장막
description: 다른 신들의 눈을 가리는 장막을 칩니다.
description_en: You draw a veil over the eyes of other gods.

name: 알려진 이름
description_en: The god's name spreads across the world.

name: 예언의 적중
description_en: Prophecies that come true draw people in.

name: 입소문
description_en: Your prophecies spread from mouth to mouth.

name: 들어맞은 예언
description_en: Each fulfilled prophecy raises your Reputation.

name: 흔들리지 않는 평판
description_en: Bad rumors do not spread easily.

name: 소문 잠재우기
description_en: Rumors of false miracles lose their power.

name: 언론의 벗
description_en: Reporters are friendly toward you.

name: 절제의 미덕
description_en: Your power to master desire grows.

name: 청빈의 감화
description_en: Followers are moved by the god's humble ways.

name: 소박한 식탁
description: 함께 먹는 소박한 밥이 신앙을 키웁니다.
description_en: Simple meals shared together nourish Piety.

name: 본보기의 삶
description_en: Even outsiders view the cult favorably.

name: 드러내지 않는 힘
description_en: You draw less envy from other gods.

name: 몸을 낮춤
description_en: You catch the gods' eyes less often.

name: 조용한 행보
description_en: You draw less suspicion from the world.

name: 인내의 미덕
description_en: Your power to endure grows.

name: 기다림의 열매
description_en: Piety accumulates as time passes.

name: 느린 전도
description_en: Each year, followers quietly increase.

name: 오래 타는 촛불
description_en: Each year, Piety deepens a little.

name: 견디는 교단
description_en: Your followers hold out against any assault.

name: 버티는 신도들
description_en: They do not easily leave, even under conversion campaigns.

name: 포위 속의 노래
description_en: Even under siege, Piety does not cool.

name: 자애의 미덕
description_en: Your heart for others grows.

name: 베푸는 손
description_en: Generosity draws people to the cult.

name: 구호의 줄
description_en: The relief line becomes a line of followers.

name: 나누는 빵
description_en: With sharing, Healing works better.

name: 감사의 방벽
description_en: Grateful neighbors shield the cult.

name: 은혜 입은 이웃
description_en: Neighbors stamp out bad rumors for you.

name: 자선의 증언
description_en: A record of charity buries suspicion.

name: 청렴의 미덕
description_en: A clear conscience becomes strength.

name: 깨끗한 이름
description_en: Word spreads of a clean cult.

name: 투명한 장부
description_en: The more you open the books, the higher your Reputation.

name: 정직한 설교
description_en: Plain words move your followers.

name: 털어도 먼지 없는
description_en: Even when investigators come, you have little to lose.

name: 조사의 무력화
description_en: You find ways to avoid seizure.

name: 결백의 증명
description_en: The world's suspicion builds up more slowly.

name: 타오르는 육욕
description_en: The heat of the flesh warms the vessel.

name: 유혹의 손짓
description_en: Temptation binds your followers deeply.

name: 간택의 밤
description_en: The memory of being chosen for a night becomes Piety.

name: 매혹의 향
description_en: Your Feasts go more smoothly.

name: 쾌락의 회복
description_en: Pleasure restores the vessel more deeply.

name: 살결의 온기
description_en: Nights spent skin to skin revive the body.

name: 달콤한 망각
description_en: Pleasure covers the wounds of the mind.

name: 끝없는 식욕
description_en: The more you eat, the fuller the vessel grows.

name: 성찬의 초대
description_en: The feast table draws people in.

name: 넘치는 잔칫상
description_en: Those with full bellies become followers.

name: 신의 포도주
description_en: A single cup of wine strengthens Faith.

name: 배부른 그릇
description_en: The vessel recovers as much as you eat and drink.

name: 보양의 식탁
description_en: Rich food revives the body.

name: 두둑한 곳간
description: 배부른 신도는 쌀자루를 따라 떠나지 않습니다.
description_en: Well-fed followers never leave for someone else's rice sacks.

name: 황금의 갈망
description_en: Your craving for riches becomes power.

name: 탐스러운 봉헌
description: 더 큰 봉헌이 더 큰 축복을 부릅니다.
description_en: Bigger Offerings summon bigger blessings.

name: 황금 헌금 경쟁
description_en: Followers compete over how much they offer.

name: 사치의 위세
description_en: Luxury becomes majesty.

name: 돈으로 사는 평화
description_en: Money quiets the world's suspicion.

name: 은밀한 로비
description_en: The edge of the investigation is dulled.

name: 빼돌린 재산
description_en: You move your Wealth before it can be seized.

name: 군림의 야망
description: 모든 것 위에 서려는 야망이 커집니다.
description_en: Your ambition to stand above all things grows.

name: 정복의 깃발
description_en: Your power swells unchecked.

name: 흡수 합병
description_en: You swallow the followers of other cults.

name: 옥좌의 위엄
description_en: Majesty flows down from on high.

name: 신들 앞의 오만
description: 다른 신들 앞에서도 고개를 숙이지 않습니다.
description_en: You refuse to bow your head even before other gods.

name: 무릎 꿇지 않는 신
description_en: Pressure from the heavens builds up more slowly.

name: 철의 질서
description_en: Your majesty does not easily crumble.
